purpose: Freeze a finite seven-route prevalue review of issuer-as-equipment-rental-operator quotation, reservation, allocation, dispatch, handover, on-hire use, extension, return, inspection, damage, maintenance, ready-to-rent, redeployment, disposal, charge, deposit, invoice, dispute, collection, refund and settlement states before any source row, formula, direction, candidate value, comparator, security price or return is read.

adjacent_mentions_only: accounting lease commitments, right-of-use assets and lease liabilities rather than issuer-operated rental reservations, physical handover, metered use, return inspection, damage and billing
owned productive asset capex and disposal rather than customer-facing rental-unit availability and contract execution
shipping charters and vehicle ownership lifecycles rather than general equipment-rental depot, unit, work-order, inspection and charge conservation
construction, freight and manufacturing execution histories with different issuer roles, asset identities and clocks

requirements: lawful public or licensed point-in-time source with first-available, correction and supersession timestamps for quotation, reservation, allocation, dispatch, handover, on-hire, extension, off-hire, return, inspection, damage, loss, maintenance, repair, ready-to-rent, redeployment, disposal, charge, deposit, invoice, dispute, collection, refund and settlement events mapped to accepted trading sessions

stable listed-parent plus privacy-safe customer, contract, reservation, rental order, asset-unit, depot, dispatch, handover, meter, inspection, damage case, work order, charge, invoice and settlement tokens without current-state projection

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including quoted, accepted, cancelled, unfulfilled, allocated, dispatched, handed-over, extended, returned and overdue rentals; available, reserved, on-hire, idle, down, damaged, lost, under-maintenance, ready, redeployed and disposed units; quoted, billed, credited, disputed, collected, refunded and settled charges

explicit missing, unavailable, rejected, cancelled, no-show, delayed, substituted, reversed, corrected, superseded, partial-return, overdue, damaged, lost, maintenance, repair, write-off, disputed, credited, refunded, settled and genuine-zero semantics with contract, asset-unit, meter, work-order and billing conservation

no natural-person or operator identity, payment credential, precise live GPS or client-site location, access credential, customer-site security record, proprietary telemetry or diagnostics, safety or security control, customer-confidential rate, unreleased equipment design, or trade secret

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Current equipment catalogs, rate cards, asset rosters, latest utilization or maintenance snapshots, and accounting PPE or lease-receivable snapshots cannot reconstruct historical reservations, allocations, handovers, meter states, returns, inspections, damage, work orders, invoices and complete applicable populations at first availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: issuer_equipment_class_age_region_depot_channel_contract_duration_utilization_damage_maintenance_rate_direction_threshold_subset_weight_interaction_combination_or_model_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting an issuer, equipment class, unit age, region, depot, channel, contract duration, utilization, damage or maintenance state, rate, direction, threshold, subset, weight, interaction, combination or model before complete lawful base histories are admitted would multiply hypotheses and exploit coverage, correction, customer-mix, asset-class and survivorship differences.

scientific_interpretation: A linked issuer-as-equipment-rental-operator reservation, asset-unit handover, metered use, return inspection, damage, maintenance and billing lifecycle is economically distinct from accounting leases, owned-asset capex, shipping charters and generic fleet KPIs. Distinction alone does not admit a factor; the absent complete lawful point-in-time privacy-safe operating source is the binding gate.
next_action: Bind the three infrastructure failures and all seven scientific routes into one append-only ledger, publish terminal prevalue evidence, and authorize a genuinely different Campaign226 domain after validation.
